contentPattern.structure: Estimated monthly premium calculator card (STUB). One row per item, cells [type | label/content | value] where type is heading, result, input, disclaimer or cta: heading + result range, N input rows (label + default value, rendered with a disabled placeholder slider), disclaimer, CTA link

cells: This is an estimate. Final rates may vary based on your coverage, shipment details, and risk profile.

suitableFor: compact single-pane estimate/quote calculator cards (stub, static defaults)
notSuitableFor: two-pane impact calculators with result visualisation (use calculator-impact)
